title: How Adam Robinson used LinkedIn reach and a free product to launch RB2B
summary: Adam Robinson explains how organic LinkedIn video built an audience that shaped RB2B's go-to-market: a massive free offer, paid features added over time, and patience on revenue. He also covers why churn depends on product category and why free users are worth keeping.

principles.text: Let your distribution advantage dictate go-to-market: a big audience makes a massive free offer work far better.
principles.quote: the LinkedIn thing was working so well I'm like you know what if I had a massive free offer and like tried to execute one of these MailChimp go to markets the free thing is going to work way better for me with this megaphone
